description.p: Eduka-Customizer builds Edukasaun OS live images from Debian stable, testing or sid: extract an ISO or bootstrap a new base, install packages and Flatpak apps, choose the desktop (Eduka-Desktop, LXQt, Xfce, KDE, GNOME and more), brand the boot splash, login screen and boot menu, edit the system live in a window, and build a hybrid BIOS/UEFI ISO.
